head: e956cd50b1f25bd95427301cced4741bb68e24f8
body:
Recovery retries now reserve cumulative work durably before reading, decoding, validating or admitting candidates. A hard kill, same-ID concurrency, malformed/deleted accounting record, or Operational/Search loss cannot reset the request allowance. Request IDs and the original finite contract are validated; successful live work alone may settle its measured reservation.

The remaining P7 hardening also bounds forensic copies/SQLite cells/JSONL/JSON/base64/proofs before unsafe materialization, reports partial/unknown input honestly, revalidates complete immutable replay/Capture/copy/Notes evidence, and stops on positively confirmed source or destination corruption. Source diagnosis distinguishes staging defects, transient/environmental failures and indeterminate integrity. Restore and activation pin filesystem identities, verify actual copied bytes, fence writers/stops, and fail closed on the tested publication races.

Verification source: `178ddbaa8fa06f52aff4993730205c5a38da91f4`, tree `9740ad1a91f367192bb31ce9777d039c2bb4729b`. Final PR head: `e956cd50b1f25bd95427301cced4741bb68e24f8` (evidence/skill follow-up only; all 368 executable input hashes match the tested source). The new #87 design `c058af3a1be9ba3e9a1b0ba649c789f5bdcd1d75` is in its ancestry; concurrent remote design merge `12f1b04` was preserved. No prior history was rewritten.

Validation:

- P7 integration: 255 tests independently executed, including actual separate processes/SIGKILL, real P1 committed WAL, unchanged source DB/WAL/SHM, P5/P6 stop entry points, exact replay and filesystem faults.
- Independent A: 612 domain/schema/compatibility nodes plus executable corruption and history counterexamples. Independent B: 65 scoped nodes and 9 filesystem/stop/process counterexamples. Independent C: 38 standalone security/crash/input counterexamples and all 255 P7 nodes. Authors explicitly excluded their own production changes from approval; other reviewers cover those changes.
- Installed wheel and wheel-from-sdist: all 255 P7 nodes each, 0 failures/errors/skips, exact JUnit/journal/collection reconciliation; all 124 packaged files match final source. Both wheels SHA-256 `dfab687567d3b3202c1ac4de0e2d1485835eb42f3a962242c05c762b5ac2e414`.
- Root complete default suite: **3517 passed / 229 failed / 2 errors** (3748 selected, exit 1). All 231 failing/error nodes independently reproduced on unchanged main, with the same normalized exception/assertion and source location: 228 inherited runtime failures (the known five plus 223 additional failures), one missing-browser docs failure, and two missing-wheelhouse setup errors. After preparing the external lock-pinned wheelhouse, both generic wheel/sdist CLI nodes passed. Original failures, a path-prefix fixture false positive, interrupted runs and tmpfs-capacity failures remain preserved. This is not whole-repository green acceptance. P1–P6 888 nodes and compatibility 49 nodes all passed; P7 integration 255 passed. Default live/stress deselections (2 nodes) are explicit.
- P1 generated schema/schema audit, implementation boundary, callsite dependencies, publication-free audit, schema visualization, Ruff lint and Ruff format all passed against the frozen source. All 63 existing public runtime Python modules and the default schema remain byte-identical to main.
- Hosted [Development CI](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/38922059845) passed its actual selected checks. Its verified receipt says `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`, runtime pytest **0**. It is not hosted P7 runtime acceptance.

[Crash inventory, raw executions, independent reports and exact-input binding](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/e956cd50b1f25bd95427301cced4741bb68e24f8/docs/implementation/evidence/p7-hardening-20261016/README.md) retain failures and interrupted/nonfinal runs separately.

Supported/tested boundary: Linux local cooperating-process filesystem contract using flock, SQLite WAL, `/proc/self/fd`, fsync and renameat2. Synthetic test catalogs ran on tmpfs, workspace/evidence on overlayfs. SIGKILL and syscall ordering do not establish physical host power-loss, disk filesystem/NFS, Windows or privileged hostile namespace guarantees. Unsupported primitives fail closed.

Scope qualifications: unsupported Context resource/field candidates remain qualified non-authoritative observations; P7 does not promise complete reconstruction of every salvaged Context table. Activation initializes empty Operational/Search stores and reports `initialized_empty`; full Search projection rebuilding is a separate P6 operation. Original external attribution stays unauthenticated under ADR 0027. The public Schema 21 runtime/default DDL is unchanged; P8 activation/integration remains future work. All tests use disposable synthetic state. No PR merge, release/tag, production recovery/activation or deliberate Pages deployment was performed.

Final evidence-head hosted follow-up: [Development run 38926458613](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/38926458613) succeeded for `e956cd50b1f25bd95427301cced4741bb68e24f8`; actual bounded receipt verified 21 members, ZIP SHA-256 `c934ed37d70a2192eaa2d858fc7aaa36000164f27288831b57fe896b0c79405a`. Its temporary merge `80c3f278592e73efc2fd4049b96c17afb3d17257` has the exact final PR tree `87cd5817c5e945b0f29b8501bfa3fda6d2674dc4`. Actual runtime execution remains **0**, `full_acceptance=false`; this does not replace the frozen-source local/installed evidence.

[Pages validation on the final evidence head](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/38926458993) also succeeded: publication safety and links had zero violations, documentation unit tests 6 passed (20.91s), deployment skipped. The local full-suite missing-browser failure is preserved rather than rewritten as a pass.
